title: barchiyo me dil ka tukda reh gaya
body:
barchiyo me dil ka tukda reh gaya
sheh ki ankhou me andhera reh gaya
aye falak sehne sitam ke waaste
kya nabi zaadou ka kunba reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
noke naiza par sare akbar ke sath
umme laila ka kaleja reh gaya
ab na wo akbar hai na husno shabaab
ha magar duniya me charcha reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
odhti kyukar rida binte ali
be kafan bhai ka laasha reh gaya
isko kehte hai wafa ehle wafa
bhar ke saqqa mashk pyasa reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jalgaye qaime ridaye chin gayi
qaana e zehra me ab kya reh gaya
jhaad ke daaman shahedee'n uthgaye
bezabaa'n marqad me tanha reh gaya
